title: Pure K9
summary: K9 cards with generic staples. K9-04 Noroi is Forbidden, and the page's combo replays add Train, Infinitrack and Gadget cards, so they use cards this list leaves out. The Level 5 K9s Normal Summon without Tributing while the opponent holds two or more cards, and Jokul and Lantern summon in pairs for Rank 5s. The K9 Quick-Play Spells turn one K9 Xyz into another, which is how K9-X "Ripper/M", the newest card, arrives and shuffles away cards from the opponent's GY or banishment.
main: Limited. Summons itself with another Level 5 from the hand, and searches a non-Aqua K9 monster.
Summons itself with a Level 5 K9 from the GY, and searches a K9 Spell/Trap.
Summoned: sends a K9 card from the Deck to the GY; summons itself once the opponent uses a hand or GY effect.
Summons itself from the hand or GY once the opponent uses a hand or GY effect, and Xyz Summons on their turn.
Limited. Searches a K9 monster; destroyed, Sets a K9 Quick-Play Spell.
Turns a K9 Xyz into another K9 Xyz and destroys a card.
Turns a K9 Xyz or Rank 5 into another K9 Xyz, keeping the materials.
Summons a K9 from the hand or GY and Xyz Summons a K9 with it.
extra: Newest support. Rank 9 from a K9 Spell/Trap: shuffles away two cards, and negates a monster effect to wipe the field.
Rank 5: searches a K9 card and Sets a K9 Quick-Play Spell; negates a hand or GY effect.
Rank 5: destroys a monster when summoned or when the opponent uses a hand or GY effect.
LIGHT Rank 5: safe the turn it arrives, and banishes a card each Standby Phase.
LIGHT Rank 9: attacks once per material and banishes in response to the opponent.
